description: The plot illustrates the performance with different chunking sizes. The x-axis is labeled with chunking sizes, has a linear scale, ranges from 200 to 1500, and has tick labels at regular intervals of 200. The y-axis has a linear scale but lacks a visible label, ranges from an unspecified lower limit to an upper limit, and has tick labels. There are multiple lines in the plot, but their specific colors, marker shapes, and line styles are not described in the text; however, based on the context, it can be inferred that the lines represent different data series. The lines change across the x-axis, with some starting at around 200 on the x-axis and ending at 1500, and most are best represented by the first 800 tokens except for one line representing SO posts. The lines exhibit various trends, including a decline in one line within the optimal range of 200–800 tokens.
